name: qa_shiftrow
title: OS-SHIFTROW: Shift + F belongs to the screen (a blank Shift + F does nothing), Song DUP PAT on Shift + Insert and the quarter jumps of Song / File / Sample load, Mixer UNMUTE / UNSOLO, Perform STORE 1..3, Config DEFAULTS (two presses within 2 s) and Left / Right pages, Record CH-10 / CH+10 (tune ten channels, RADIO page only) and Left / Right pages. Changes device settings (Config MIDI page CLOCK MODE, put back by the steps) and the Song order of the open project (undone by the steps); the radio parts need the Si4703 and the file parts need a card with at least five entries in the folder in view

steps.say: OS-SHIFTROW, rows QA-SNG-002/003, QA-SLD-015, QA-FIL-002, QA-REC-011/012, QA-MIX-003/004, QA-PRF-002/003, QA-CFG-031..033 and QA-GLB-013 of docs/qa/catalogue. Needs a project open with a song of at least two slots (the demo or the t-v16 project) and the transport stopped

steps.note: (Shift released, in case a former run left it down)
(a leftover overlay is put away: F8 is Back)

steps.say: QA-GLB-013: a Shift + F key with nothing worth a key does nothing and never runs the plain key. Config > MIDI: Shift + F2 would be DISPLAY if it fell through

steps.note: still the MIDI page: Shift + F2 did not go to DISPLAY
nor to USB, and no jump of the rows (the quarter jumps are Song's, File's and Sample load's)
QA-GLB-013: the MIDI page as before; the Shift row (held) is QA-CFG-015

steps.say: QA-CFG-031 / 032: DEFAULTS. CLOCK MODE (row 3) is turned, Shift + F7 asks, a second Shift + F7 within two seconds puts the page back. The setting is written to the card by the unit when the page is left

steps.note: CLOCK MODE
CLOCK MODE: Master
QA-CFG-031: the first press asks
QA-CFG-032: the second press, well inside two seconds
CLOCK MODE reads Off, the default; the row under the cursor is where it was

steps.say: the window is two seconds: a first press, a 2.5 s wait and a second press must only ask again (the page is not reset). The steps below check that CLOCK MODE stays Master

steps.note: too late: it asked again
CLOCK MODE still reads Master
CLOCK MODE back to Off (the default) for good

steps.say: QA-CFG-033 (OS-CFG-ARROWS): the pages are the F-keys and the Config button, never the arrows; Left / Right edit the row (QA-CFG-240)

steps.note: F6 is PATTERN
the Config button again from PATTERN wraps to MIDI
F4 is INFO

steps.say: QA-SNG-002 / 003: Song. Shift + F2 jumps the list to a quarter; Shift + Insert adds a slot holding a COPY of the pattern (one undo unit: F8 takes it back)

steps.note: QA-SNG-002: the cursor is a quarter down the order list (the simulator's list is not the unit's: read the position)
QA-SNG-003: a new slot after the cursor with a new pattern number (the info line says SHIFT+INS DUP)
undo: the slot goes (one unit)

steps.say: QA-MIX-003 / 004: Mixer. F7 mutes the strip under the cursor, Shift + F7 unmutes every strip; F8 solos, Shift + F8 unsolos every strip; F8 on Pattern undoes each as one unit

steps.note: T1 and T2 muted
QA-MIX-003: no strip muted (the dotted row under the faders is all plain)
T2 solo
QA-MIX-004: no strip soloed

steps.say: QA-PRF-002 / 003: Perform. Shift + F1 stores scene 1 at once (STORE 1); the plain F1 is SCENE 1 again and recalls it, no Global jump shadows it

steps.note: QA-PRF-002
the message runs out
QA-PRF-003: a tap recalls the scene that was just stored (the slots are what they were)
not SCENE IS EMPTY: the scene was stored by the Shift key

steps.say: QA-REC-011 / 012: Record. Needs the radio chip. The Sample Rec button turns the page (Left / Right edit the row since OS-CFG-ARROWS); on RADIO Shift + F6 / F5 (CH+10 / CH-10) tune ten channels (1.0 MHz) up / down without the chip's seek (the plain F5 / F6 are the seek); on SOURCES and RESAMPLE the Shift row is blank and the keys do nothing

steps.note: QA-REC-012: SOURCES, the button twice, RADIO
the frequency before
QA-REC-011
the frequency is 1.0 MHz higher (87.5 to 88.5 from the default), no seek was started
and back
RADIO, the button: wraps to SOURCES
SOURCES: blank Shift + F6, nothing happens
the frequency is the one of the line above: SOURCES does not tune

steps.say: QA-SLD-015 / QA-FIL-002: the quarter jumps on the card's lists. Needs a folder in view with several entries (the card's root). Shift + F5 goes to the last entry, Shift + F1 to the first, Shift + F3 to the half way one

steps.note: QA-SLD-015: the cursor is on the last entry of the list
the cursor is on the first entry
QA-FIL-002: the cursor is on the last entry of the project list
the cursor is on the first entry
